from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection with its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
